Problem: Navigation links crowd together with 12px font size before mobile hamburger triggers at 780px
Recommendation: Adjust mobile navigation breakpoint to 980px or reduce intermediate desktop gap
AcceptanceCriteria: Navigation links maintain minimum 20px padding and 14px font without collision

Problem: 10px–11px font size on mobile viewports falls below recommended 12px accessibility readability floor
Recommendation: Enforce minimum 12px floor for all tertiary labels and metadata using --font-data
AcceptanceCriteria: No text node renders below 12px computed font size across all breakpoints

Problem: Submission validation errors display visually but lack role='alert' / aria-live='assertive' announcement for screen readers
Recommendation: Add role='alert' and aria-describedby to invalid field inputs
AcceptanceCriteria: Screen readers immediately announce error summary and focus first invalid input

Problem: Step labels wrap awkwardly on narrow mobile screens causing uneven vertical height
Recommendation: Implement responsive step counter ('Step 1 of 4') on screens under 420px with compact progress indicator
AcceptanceCriteria: Stepper occupies clean single-line bar without text clipping on 360px viewport

Problem: Curated grid transitions abruptly from 3 columns to 1 column at 780px without a 2-column tablet intermediate
Recommendation: Introduce 2-column grid between 780px and 1024px with staggered margin-top reset
AcceptanceCriteria: Tablet viewports display balanced 2-column cards with consistent vertical rhythm

Problem: Lacks immediate visual scale indicator (human silhouette or room reference) to gauge multi-meter resin tables
Recommendation: Add proportional scale badge and dimension diagram tab in specifications drawer
AcceptanceCriteria: Product detail displays clear human/room scale comparison next to written dimensions

Problem: Modal input does not auto-focus on open and lacks dedicated tap-outside dismiss buffer on mobile touch
Recommendation: Add autoFocus to search input upon transition end and 48px touch-dismiss backdrop
AcceptanceCriteria: Search input receives instant keyboard focus and backdrop click reliably dismisses modal

Problem: Category tags wrap across multiple lines pushing the arrow indicator outside visible row boundary
Recommendation: Refactor categoryRow grid to 2-tier flexible layout for viewports under 400px
AcceptanceCriteria: Category row content wraps cleanly within viewport without horizontal scroll

Problem: WYSIWYG editor toolbar in Tiptap content editor unpins on small laptop screens causing excessive vertical scrolling
Recommendation: Make formatting toolbar sticky (top: var(--header-height)) with backdrop-filter blur
AcceptanceCriteria: Rich-text toolbar remains accessible throughout long article edits on all laptop viewports

Problem: Hero and world card sizes attribute allocates 90vw on tablet where CSS container renders at 45vw
Recommendation: Fine-tune sizes string to match exact CSS container widths at 768px and 1024px
AcceptanceCriteria: Browser downloads correctly scaled responsive image derivatives without byte waste

Problem: Certain dark elevated cards rely on browser default focus outlines which have low contrast on midnight backgrounds
Recommendation: Apply uniform outline: 2px solid var(--focus-on-dark) with outline-offset: 4px across all links and buttons
AcceptanceCriteria: Keyboard navigation shows crisp #E6BA85 focus ring on 100% of interactive elements

Problem: Order card grip handle ⠿ lacks clear touch dragging visual feedback on iPad and touch displays
Recommendation: Add subtle elevated lift and active shadow when touch-pointer capture initiates on drag handle
AcceptanceCriteria: Touch dragging provides immediate visual card lift and drop target highlight

Problem: Question reordering in form builder is mouse-only with no keyboard Tab + Arrow key alternative
Recommendation: Add accessible 'Move Up' and 'Move Down' keyboard actions to question items
AcceptanceCriteria: Staff can fully reorder and configure form schema using keyboard only

Problem: Footer copyright and legal links wrap into tightly squeezed 2-line stacks on narrow mobile screens
Recommendation: Reorganize footerBottom into full-width stacked column on screens under 380px
AcceptanceCriteria: Footer links have minimum 44px tap area and clean vertical alignment on 360px viewport

Problem: If customer browser denies clipboard permissions the fallback manual copy textarea lacks one-click 'Select All' button
Recommendation: Add 'Select All Text' helper button to make manual copy frictionless on mobile iOS/Android
AcceptanceCriteria: Customer can copy entire 800+ character brief in two taps when clipboard API is restricted
